notes.title: Differences Between the Demo and Early Access Versions
notes.notes:
[p]Hello Adventurers![/p][p]This is the development team of [b]“VIractal: World of Viractalia.”[/b]
We’re excited to announce that the [b]Early Access version[/b] is finally available!
Here’s a look at some of the major new features that go far beyond the demo version.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h2][b]Co-op Play is Here![/b][/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45600267/35468f981fd740f63dbed598aaecf430a5057725.png"][/img]At last, online co-op has arrived![/p][p]Now you can set out on adventures together with players from afar.[/p][p]And there are even special features you can only experience in online play...!?[/p][p][/p][h2][b]New Characters Join the Adventure![/b][/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45600267/5ff8d077f82c503f2f514c97c3e417ca4083fb0b.png"][/img]In the demo, only the Hero and the Mage were available.[/p][p]But in Early Access, the [b]Warrior[/b] and the [b]Thief[/b] have joined the roster![/p][p]With more freedom in party composition, the possibilities for adventure have greatly expanded.[/p][p][/p][h2][b]Evolving Maps![/b][/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45600267/f5f6c276f70975b0a3480f4ceabbd5d8cd992148.png"][/img]We’ve added brand-new map objects![/p][p]On top of that, pieces placed on high ground may now be hidden under [b]“Cloud Tiles”[/b], keeping their contents a mystery until you draw near.[/p][p]This brings an extra layer of tension and excitement to every expedition.[/p][p][/p][h2][b]Battle System Updates[/b][/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45600267/a150d963d5632a2b8bff761b7305948793ba038b.png"][/img]One of the biggest changes is the introduction of [b]Enemy Action Preview[/b], allowing you to see the type of move an enemy will take next—making your strategy much more tactical.[/p][p]We’ve also made significant adjustments to enemy behavior.
Many new actions have been added, including unique behaviors that only appear under special conditions, making battles more complex and rewarding than ever.[/p][p][/p][h2][b]Over 80 New Events![/b][/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45600267/5124beb1ecbb733cc574055779cd64f09a5cbecf.png"][/img]The Early Access version introduces [b]80+ brand-new events[/b]![/p][p]You’ll also find a huge variety of new abilities and items, ensuring that every adventure feels fresh and completely different from the last.[/p][p][/p][h2][b]Expanded Out-of-Game Features[/b][/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45600267/33072777ce65a9f355bc7a94024e4f5becd8608c.png"][/img]Your [b]Adventure Base[/b] outside the board game has also grown with new facilities:[/p][list][*][p][b]Alchemy Table[/b]: Unlock new pieces and cards[/p][/*][*][p][b]Shelf[/b]: Collect the pieces you discover during your adventures[/p][/*][*][p][b]Poster[/b]: The Game Master may share helpful hints...!?[/p][/*][/list][p]And that’s not all—hidden features are waiting for you. Be sure to explore every corner![/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p]Beyond what we’ve introduced here, many more new features have been added.
Whether you play solo or with friends, dive in and experience every corner of this adventure to the fullest![/p][p][/p][table equalcells="1" colwidth="305,"][tr][th notes.title: Streaming & Content Guidelines
notes.notes:
[h2]Introduction[/h2][p]Thank you for your interest in [i]VIractal: World of Viractalia[/i]!
We are delighted to see players enjoy the game through livestreams and video content, and to share those experiences with others.[/p][p]These guidelines summarize the rules to help you create content with peace of mind. No prior application or permission is required—please feel free to make use of them![/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h2]Scope of Streaming & Posting[/h2][p]You may stream or post content covering the overall gameplay of [i]VIractal: World of Viractalia[/i], including:[/p][list][*][p]Cutscenes and story events[/p][/*][*][p]Special effects and cinematic moments[/p][/*][*][p]Boss battles[/p][/*][*][p]Online multiplayer sessions[/p][/*][/list][p][i]Note: For future updates or additional content with significant story elements, we may ask for temporary restrictions. If so, we will make an official announcement.[/i][/p][p][/p][h2]Monetization[/h2][p]Monetization is allowed on the following platforms:[/p][list][*][p]YouTube (Partner Program)[/p][/*][*][p]Twitch (Affiliate / Partner)[/p][/*][*][p]Niconico (Creator Incentive Program)[/p][/*][*][p]Other similar services in line with the above[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Credit Attribution (Optional but Recommended)[/h2][p]#VIractal [/p][p]© 2025 STING Co., Ltd. All rights reserved.[/p][p]Steam: [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2909580/VIractal/"]https://store.steampowered.com/app/2909580/VIractal/[/url][/p][p][/p][h2]Recommended Hashtags[/h2][list][*][p]#VIractal[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Prohibited Uses[/h2][p]Please refrain from the following:[/p][list][*][p]Uploading or using only in-game BGM (soundtrack)[/p][/*][*][p]Posting cinematic scenes on their own without gameplay context[/p][/*][*][p]Using illegally obtained or modified game data[/p][/*][*][p]Posting defamatory, offensive, or otherwise inappropriate content[/p][/*][*][p]Combining game content with third-party materials that infringe on others’ rights[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]About Spoilers[/h2][p]If your content includes important story events or dramatic scenes, we kindly ask you to add a “Spoiler Warning” in the video title or description.[/p][p][/p][h2]For Corporations & Media[/h2][p]If you represent a company, media outlet, or corporate-affiliated streamer and wish to broadcast this game, please contact us through:
[/p][p][url="https://www.sting.co.jp/contact/"]https://www.sting.co.jp/contact/[/url][/p][p][/p][h2]Updates to the Guidelines[/h2][p]These guidelines may be updated or modified without prior notice, especially in line with future updates to the game. Please check our official X (Twitter) account and website for the latest information.[/p][p][/p][h2]A Small Request[/h2][p][i]VIractal: World of Viractalia[/i] is a cooperative game, but you may occasionally experience a bit of playful mischief between players.
Once the adventure ends, it’s reset time—please don’t carry negative feelings outside the game, and keep enjoying the experience with a positive spirit![/p][p][/p][h2]Closing[/h2][p]Your livestreams and videos truly encourage us as developers.
We hope you continue to enjoy [i]VIractal: World of Viractalia[/i] and help share its charm with even more people around the world.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][b]Effective Date:[/b] September 22, 2025[/p]

notes.title: Known Issues (As of 9/19)
notes.notes: [p]Below are the issues currently confirmed by the development team.[/p][p]These will either be fixed in an upcoming patch or are still under investigation.[/p][p][/p][table equalcells="1" colwidth="275,"][tr][th colwidth="275"][p]Issue[/p][/th][th][p]Details[/p][/th][/tr][tr][td colwidth="275"][p]Controller Input Not Working[/p][/td][td][p]In rare cases, controller input may not respond.[/p][p][i]Workaround:[/i] If this occurs, try using the keyboard to continue playing.[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td colwidth="275"][p]Online Session Stuck[/p][/td][td][p]During online play, the game may sometimes remain stuck on “waiting for other players.”[/p][p][i]Workaround:[/i] Restart the game and continue from your save data.[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td colwidth="275"][p]Item “Fairy Tale False Wings” Effect Not Triggering[/p][/td][td][p]The effect of the item [i]Fairy Tale False Wings[/i] does not activate.[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td colwidth="275"][p]Unintended Ability Activation from Block Gain Effects[/p][/td][td][p]Abilities that trigger upon gaining blocks may also trigger when blocks are reduced due to skill card effects.[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td colwidth="275"][p]Battle-Only Ability Persisting[/p][/td][td][p]When using the skill card [i]Adrenaline[/i] to learn the ability [i]Fragile Regeneration[/i], the ability should disappear after battle. However, in online play, it may remain active even after the battle ends.[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td colwidth="275"][p]Ability “Thief’s Secret” Has No Effect[/p][/td][td][p]The ability [i]Thief’s Secret[/i] does not apply its intended “Steal” bonus effect.[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td colwidth="275"][p]Skill Card “Multi Shuriken+” Description Mismatch[/p][/td][td][p]The description currently states: [i]“Deals additional damage if the target is both Bound and Slowed.”[/i][/p][p]The correct effect is: [i]“Deals additional damage if the target is either Bound or Slowed.”[/i][/p][/td][/tr][tr][td colwidth="275"][p]Incorrect Event Trigger During “Exploration”[/p][/td][td][p]In some cases, the event triggered may not match the option selected during [i]Exploration[/i].[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td colwidth="275"][p]Staff Roll Not Displayed[/p][/td][td][p]When the staff roll is displayed in languages other than Japanese, the text does not appear.[/p][p][i]Note:[/i] The staff roll can still be viewed somewhere in the game.[/p][/td][/tr][/table]

notes.title: Roadmap Revealed!
notes.notes:
[p]Hello everyone! This is the development team of [b]“VIractal: World of Viractalia.”[/b]
Today, we’d like to share our plans for the [b]major updates[/b] coming after the Early Access launch.[/p][p]“VIractal: World of Viractalia” will continue to evolve step by step.
We want to build this game together with our players, so please look forward to what’s ahead![/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h2]Upcoming Major Updates[/h2][p]In this roadmap, we’ve prepared [b]three large-scale updates[/b].[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45600267/312b262ec5973635cfeba9c0b0250d928c60af81.png"][/img][/p][h3]October: Update #1 “Skyharmonia”[/h3][list][*][p]New stage “Stage 2,” themed around clouds and ice[/p][/*][*][p]Various feature updates[/p][/*][*][p]New character added[/p][/*][*][p]New memos[/p][/*][*][p]New cards for existing characters[/p][/*][*][p]New events[/p][/*][/list][p]The mystical stage “Skyharmonia,” covered in clouds and ice, will be the setting for your next adventure.
With new characters and cards, the strategies at your disposal will expand even further![/p][p][/p][h3]November: Update #2 “Demon Lord’s Castle”[/h3][list][*][p]New stage “Stage 3,” set in fiery volcanoes and a dark castle[/p][/*][*][p]New character added[/p][/*][*][p]Introduction of new alchemy cards[/p][/*][*][p]New objects to expand strategic options[/p][/*][*][p]UI/UX improvements[/p][/*][*][p]New memos[/p][/*][*][p]New events[/p][/*][*][p]New items[/p][/*][/list][p]The Demon Lord’s castle, standing in a land of molten lava, becomes the climactic stage.
Here, the final battle against the Demon Lord awaits!
New characters, objects, and items will broaden your playstyle, while UI improvements will make the game even smoother to enjoy.[/p][p][/p][h3]December: Update #3 “????”[/h3][list][*][p]A mysterious new stage, “Stage ???”[/p][/*][*][p]First guest character (Ver.1) joins the game[/p][/*][*][p]New character added[/p][/*][*][p]New achievements[/p][/*][*][p]New memos[/p][/*][*][p]New events[/p][/*][/list][p]Details remain a secret for now, but this stage will play a key role in unraveling the hero’s journey.
And for the first time, a [b]guest character[/b] will appear — carrying a very familiar giant sword…![/p][p][/p][h3]From January and Beyond[/h3][list][*][p]Continuous addition of new characters[/p][/*][*][p]Guest Character Ver.2 scheduled to join[/p][/*][/list][p]Even after the major updates, we’ll keep rolling out smaller updates, adding new characters and reflecting player feedback.
Once all planned content is complete, we aim to move toward the official release![/p][p][/p][h2]A Request to Our Players[/h2][p]Creating a single stage in [b]“VIractal: World of Viractalia”[/b] requires building a huge number of events, and with the many random elements in the game, balancing and development take time.
Our team truly values your feedback and will continue adjusting the game’s balance and playability based on your voices.[/p][p]To help us make the game even better, we’d love your support!
If you enjoyed the game, please consider leaving a [b]Steam review or rating[/b].
And if you have suggestions or requests, feel free to share them with us through the [b]feedback form[/b].[/p]

notes.title: “VIractal: World of Viractalia” Early Access Begins!
notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45600267/3d24719fb912dbd3c7b635222e6290d08fa79235.png"][/img][/p][p][i]VIractal: World of Viractalia[/i] is a board game-style RPG where strategy and chance collide. Explore a randomly generated miniature world by rolling dice, forge your path through countless encounters, and engage in strategic deck-building battles with high replayability.[/p][p]The adventure begins as you awaken in a mysterious room, stripped of your memories. With each roll of the dice, you’ll uncover handcrafted stages full of secrets and surprises.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Featured in Early Access: [i]The Dragon’s Garden[/i][/b][/p][p]This release introduces the [i]“Dragon’s Garden”[/i] stage, set atop a vast mountain range where a colossal dragon slumbers.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45600267/068488f23bc2c061907abb9f803c5b80c6afc715.png"][/img][/p][p]Countless encounters and trials await—grow your characters, form bonds, and prepare for the ultimate showdown with the mighty dragon.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45600267/3785201eb017ca0cf2f3049d3bef3a5ab573a2c6.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45600267/1358c45a748aad1fe74c60c86ea4ee36cccced76.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45600267/5124beb1ecbb733cc574055779cd64f09a5cbecf.png"][/img][/p][p]Beyond the board, the [b]Game Room[/b] lets you collect figures from your journeys and unlock new pieces or cards using your rewards. Build and customize your own space as your adventures unfold.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45600267/b03214132ab7c86f80e3f21ba2f59069b31101aa.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45600267/33072777ce65a9f355bc7a94024e4f5becd8608c.png"][/img][/p][p]Online play may also lead to unexpected rivalries and mind games with other players. Whether you venture alone or alongside friends, your adventure is yours to shape.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45600267/3d8f4ea044197c4a2cbee9aa800545cdeef476b3.png"][/img][/p][p]Experience a one-of-a-kind fusion of strategy, chance, and discovery—[/p][p][i]VIractal: World of Viractalia[/i] is waiting for you![/p]
